findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: code_url · Private data: id_gs1, code_url, code_jwt, geo_geohash · Public sink: time_dst · Destructive: id_security.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: code_url · Private data: id_gs1, code_url, code_jwt, geo_geohash · Public sink: time_dst · Destructive: id_security

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
